item.title: The slowest page is rarely the home page.
item.description:
Teams tune the home page and forget the pages people reach from search. Measure every page you link to, in the order a visitor would open them.
Try this today: List your five most visited pages from analytics and time each one. Fix the slowest first.
How a public-page review works, step by step: https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=tips-2026-10&utm_content=slowest-page

item.title: The missing CSP: anything can crawl in.
item.description:
Without a Content-Security-Policy header, the browser runs any script that ends up in your page, including one an attacker injected.
Exorcise it today: Check your response headers for Content-Security-Policy. Start in report-only mode, read the reports, then enforce it.
How a public-page review works, step by step: https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review-guide.html?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=horror-headers-2026-10&utm_content=missing-csp
#Halloween #CyberSecurity #Vulnerability #QA #CSP #QAlab
